# Member actions
{: .no_toc }

Change a member's role or remove them.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ORG-05` |
| **Route** | `/orgs/:orgId/members/:userId` · deep link `substratal://orgs/:orgId/members/:userId` |
| **Where** | Personal › Organizations |
| **Who can use it** | org_admin / organizations.manage |
| **Kind** | confirm |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwAlertDialog` (`extra-child` for fields) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Role | radio-group | body.role |  | GtkCheckButton group |
| Remove from organization | destructive-button | DELETE …/members/{userId} | COPY confirm | GtkButton .destructive-action |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Change role | `PATCH /organizations/{id}/members/{userId}` | 409 → last admin can't be demoted (explain). |
| Remove | `DELETE /organizations/{id}/members/{userId}` | 409 → last admin can't leave/remove. |
